one_current_parent.extraction_prior: Author explicitly assumes pure M1 for DeltaI1 when extracting absolute M1 strengths. f_Ma=f_Eb=1 is conditional use of that M1 prior and the author's E2 assignment; no measured delta or proof that all allowed higher amplitudes vanish is added.
one_current_parent.printed_basis_unknown: TableI does not identify photon-relative versus total-level/pair branching or the full IC handling. The two interpretations below are alternatives, not a decision about the authors' actual algorithm.

definitions_and_units.rates: lambda_gamma_a is the entire401.2-keV photon line; fa=lambda_gamma_M1,a/lambda_gamma_a. fb=lambda_gamma_E2,b/lambda_gamma_b. They are radiative rate fractions, not total-decay branch fractions.
definitions_and_units.source_unit_equations: lambda_gamma_M1=K_M1 E_a(MeV)^3 B_M1[mu_N^2]; lambda_gamma_E2=K_E2 E_b(MeV)^5 B_E2[e^2b^2]. The K conventions are the already audited modern-unit realization of LKH82 Eq2.2.
definitions_and_units.reported_ratio_unit: mu_N^2/(e^2 b^2); this is not a dimensionless strength ratio. The photon partial-rate ratio is dimensionless. Fixed-unit numerical values can be logged by dividing by their respective reference units.
definitions_and_units.common_parent_tau: tau is one common mean level lifetime, positive; no second parent or fitted lifetime is introduced.
definitions_and_units.photon_intensities: Ia,Ib,Ic must be proportional to the same-parent physical photon rates after efficiency, angular/gate/feeding/contamination corrections under the same preparation. Their overall arbitrary scale cancels.
definitions_and_units.alpha: alpha_j is an effective full pair non-gamma/photon factor only when the corresponding ledger is closed. Ordinary all-shell total ICC can serve this role if it accounts for every relevant pair non-gamma contribution; alpha_K alone cannot.
definitions_and_units.positive_chart: Ia,Ib,Ea,Eb,Ks,tau,s,D>0,0<fa,fb<=1,0<=b_extra<1. At a zero selected component log derivatives/ratios require endpoint treatment.

photon_relative_route.absolute_common_factor: D=sum_all photonI_j(1+alpha_j), including any missing photon contributions represented by D_missing; Z=s(1-b_extra)/(tau D). BM=Z Ia fa/(KM Ea^3), BE=Z Ib fb/(KE Eb^5).
photon_relative_route.current_input_expression: R=(KE/KM)*(0.7574^5/0.4012^3)*(0.57/0.24)*(f_Ma/f_Eb), in mu_N^2/(e^2 b^2), if those printed fractions are photon-relative inputs with the stated corrections.
photon_relative_route.exact_cancellation: Common tau, strength scale s, photon/total normalization D, third/missing branches that enter only D, global extra non-gamma fraction and all ICC dependence confined to that shared D cancel exactly. A ratio may be usable when an absolute-strength normalization is not closed, provided the selected corrected photon-rate ratio and fractions are independently valid.
photon_relative_route.missing_branch_boundary: This does not excuse unresolved contamination, gate/feeding biases or missing contributions to the selected line intensities. Those modify Ia/Ib rather than only D. An extra already included in alpha_j must not also be added as b_extra.
photon_relative_route.selected_two_renormalization: Dividing both selected intensities by0.81 leaves their ratio unchanged. It gives an incorrect absolute normalization if it discards the0.19 line. Ratio agreement cannot validate the absolute B ledger or detect every shared bias.

true_total_pair_route.definition: beta_j=lambda_pair,j/lambda_level_total, where the pair includes its full gamma plus non-gamma rates. For true total branches, gamma fraction is beta_j/(1+alpha_j); do not apply an extra global missing fraction a second time.
true_total_pair_route.same_numbers_comparison: Interpreting the same printed0.57/0.24 numbers as true total pairs changes the photon-basis ratio by h_b/h_a, where h_j=1+alpha_j. This is a forward conditional comparison, not an inferred source input.
true_total_pair_route.consistent_conversion: If beta_j=(1-b_extra)Ij h_j/D is actually converted from the same photon ledger, beta_a/beta_b=(Ia/Ib)h_a/h_b and the two physical formulas agree.
true_total_pair_route.what_does_not_cancel: Branch-specific h_a/h_b remains. A common multiplicative factor in both h values cancels; a shared additive change of both alphas generally leaves sensitivity1/h_b-1/h_a. Correlation alone does not make unequal response coefficients cancel.

It is not a common fractional B error. Changing MeV to keV with consistent K conversion is a unit change and preserves the physical reported ratio.
exact_log_Jacobians.total_pair_energy_response: For the true total-pair route at fixed beta ratio/fractions/Ks, if alpha is recomputed with calibrated energy, dlnR/dlnu=2+dln(1+alpha_b)/dlnu-dln(1+alpha_a)/dlnu. For each alpha depending on its own line energy, this is2+Eb alpha_b'(Eb)/(1+alpha_b)-Ea alpha_a'(Ea)/(1+alpha_a). The symbolic check chooses no atomic response function or numerical derivative.
exact_log_Jacobians.upstream_chain_rule: The zero explicit tau/ICC-normalizer columns hold at fixed selected corrected intensities/fractions. If a stopping/feeding/mixing/calibration nuisance also changes Ia,Ib,fa,fb or energy, chain those dependencies into the same primitive-input Jacobian; they need not cancel.

covariance_and_no_double_count.exact_log_coordinate_law: For actual y=(ln Z,ln Ia,ln Ib,ln fa,ln fb,ln Ea,ln Eb) with finite covariance, ln B is affine with matrix A below. Thus Cov(ln B)=A Sigma_y A^T and Var(ln R)=h Sigma_y h^T are exact; no Gaussianity is required.
covariance_and_no_double_count.common_factor: If an uncertainty acts only as the same multiplicative s on both Bs, its log covariance component is var(ln s)*[[1,1],[1,1]]. The contrast(1,-1) annihilates it. Cross-covariances of the common log Z also disappear from this log ratio.
covariance_and_no_double_count.raw_input_covariance: For covariance specified in raw intensities, energies, alphas or nonlinearly derived Z, use the exact derivatives with J Sigma_raw J^T as a local delta-method approximation, or propagate the full joint distribution. Published raw-unit error bars are not an actual log-coordinate covariance. Var(R) or a confidence interval is not fixed by Var(ln R) alone.
covariance_and_no_double_count.total_alpha_coordinates: The total-pair log formula is affine if using ln h_a,ln h_b; its coefficients are-1,+1. In raw alpha coordinates the exact derivatives are-1/h_a,+1/h_b and covariance conversion is nonlinear.
covariance_and_no_double_count.primitive_input_policy: Use one shared tau/normalization/fit nuisance once, with its cross-covariances. Do not independently add the two derived B errors, then add the same common factor again. If alpha_mix or angular efficiency is derived from the same mixing parameter, chain it rather than treating those errors as unrelated inputs.
covariance_and_no_double_count.actual_covariance: None supplied or constructed. The symbolic covariance identities and common-factor matrix are algebra, not estimates from MU08 or from a15% stopping label.

conditional_errorbar_consistency.premises: Suppose the three quantities are one random vector, their sum is exactly1 for every sample, all have finite second moments, and0.06/0.02/0.02 are their true joint marginal standard deviations.
conditional_errorbar_consistency.distribution_free_proof: For centered variables Xa+Xb+Xc=0, Xa=-(Xb+Xc). The L2 norm triangle gives sigma_a<=sigma_b+sigma_c, with no Gaussian or first-order assumption.
conditional_errorbar_consistency.printed_scales_check: 0.06>0.02+0.02=0.04, so that specific simultaneous marginal-SD interpretation is inconsistent.
conditional_errorbar_consistency.optional_rounding_condition: If each SD was rounded to nearest0.01 with half-unit ranges, sigma_a>=0.055 while sigma_b+sigma_c<=0.025+0.025=0.05; that particular rounding model alone would not remove the inconsistency. No such reporting model is asserted as fact.
conditional_errorbar_consistency.inference_boundary: This is not author error, an inferred negative/actual covariance, or proof of hidden branches. The source does not supply the estimator/coverage/normalization/covariance definition needed to decide which premise fails. Center sums1 alone do not establish per-sample normalization. No quoted B value is used to recover an input or an actual covariance matrix.
Default reads only; --write-receipt exclusively creates one authorized JSON.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from fractions import Fraction as F
import hashlib

from pathlib import Path
import sys

OUT_REL=RUN_REL+"/day9-same-parent-strength-ratio.json"
UNIT_REL=RUN_REL+"/day9-strength-unit-audit.json"
UNIT_SHA="0913dc388d5852c1d95bdf6fdc4007602748eed97504fda903fef911a6295a1d"
FO_REL=RUN_REL+"/day9-vacancy-sensitivity.json"
FO_SHA="a4969d02768572343d2917b3fba16e29310b7e8d5b2a2bceac229c2ee6ec3613"
RAW={
    "LKH82":("raw/papers/gpt/high-spin-20260920/review/1982_Lange et al_E0-E2-M1 multipole admixtures of transitions in even-even nuclei.pdf","ed925a0577a9257903806acd209c1db707529e86a5bfd9a301a83d597bf78ffb"),
    "MU08":("raw/papers/gpt/high-spin-20260920/三轴/手征/2008_Mukhopadhyay et al_Electromagnetic transition rates in high-spin bands in Nd 136.pdf","ea77d7d033051369d19aad2f82a542e91e262eb490d518b246f7f04c2d0dcd2c"),
}


def digest(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def build_receipt(root):
    deps="tmp/day8-20261007/rose-brink/python-deps"
    sys.path.insert(0,str(root/deps))
    import sympy as sp
    counts=Counter()
    def check(name,condition):
        if not bool(condition):raise AssertionError(name)
        counts[name]+=1
    def eq(a,b):return sp.simplify(a-b)==0
    def st(e):return str(sp.factor(sp.simplify(e)))
    def sm(m):return [[st(m[i,j]) for j in range(m.cols)] for i in range(m.rows)]

    protected={UNIT_REL:UNIT_SHA,FO_REL:FO_SHA}
    protected.update({rel:sha for rel,sha in RAW.values()})
    for rel,sha in protected.items():check("immutable_input_before",digest(root/rel)==sha)
    prior=json.loads((root/UNIT_REL).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    oldFO=json.loads((root/FO_REL).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    run=json.loads((root/RUN_REL/"run.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    check("parent_day8_preserved",run["day_index"]==8)

    Ia,Ib,Ic,s,tau,Ea,Eb,fa,fb,KM,KE=sp.symbols("I_a I_b I_c s tau E_a E_b f_Ma f_Eb K_M1 K_E2",positive=True)
    aa,ab,ac,missing=sp.symbols("alpha_a alpha_b alpha_c D_missing",nonnegative=True)
    extra=sp.symbols("b_extra",nonnegative=True)
    ha,hb,hc=1+aa,1+ab,1+ac
    D=Ia*ha+Ib*hb+Ic*hc+missing
    common=s*(1-extra)/(tau*D)
    BM=common*Ia*fa/(KM*Ea**3)
    BE=common*Ib*fb/(KE*Eb**5)
    Rphot=sp.cancel(BM/BE)
    expected=KE/KM*Eb**5/Ea**3*Ia/Ib*fa/fb
    check("photon_ratio_exact",eq(Rphot,expected))
    variables=[s,tau,Ia,Ib,Ic,extra,aa,ab,ac,fa,fb,Ea,Eb,missing]
    log_coordinate=[True,True,True,True,True,False,False,False,False,True,True,True,True,False]
    def log_jac(expr):return sp.Matrix([[sp.simplify((var if logflag else 1)*sp.diff(expr,var)/expr) for var,logflag in zip(variables,log_coordinate)]])
    JM,JE=log_jac(BM),log_jac(BE)
    H=JM-JE
    expected_H=sp.Matrix([[0,0,1,-1,0,0,0,0,0,1,-1,-3,5,0]])
    check("exact_photon_log_J_contrast",all(eq(a,b) for a,b in zip(H,expected_H)))
    check("ratio_log_J_matches_direct",all(eq(a,b) for a,b in zip(H,log_jac(Rphot))))
    vscale=sp.symbols("v_scale",positive=True)
    check("common_intensity_scale_cancels_each_B",eq(BM.subs({Ia:vscale*Ia,Ib:vscale*Ib,Ic:vscale*Ic,missing:vscale*missing},simultaneous=True),BM)
        and eq(BE.subs({Ia:vscale*Ia,Ib:vscale*Ib,Ic:vscale*Ic,missing:vscale*missing},simultaneous=True),BE))
    check("common_strength_scale_cancels_ratio",eq((vscale*BM)/(vscale*BE),Rphot))
    check("common_energy_calibration_has_plus_two",eq(Rphot.subs({Ea:vscale*Ea,Eb:vscale*Eb},simultaneous=True),vscale**2*Rphot))
    check("wrong_shared_absolute_normalizer_hidden_by_ratio",eq((BM/sp.Rational(81,100))/(BE/sp.Rational(81,100)),Rphot))

    ba,bb=sp.symbols("beta_total_a beta_total_b",positive=True)
    BMtot=s*ba*fa/(tau*KM*Ea**3*ha)
    BEtot=s*bb*fb/(tau*KE*Eb**5*hb)
    Rtot=sp.cancel(BMtot/BEtot)
    check("total_pair_ratio_exact",eq(Rtot,KE/KM*Eb**5/Ea**3*ba/bb*fa/fb*hb/ha))
    total_vars=[s,tau,ba,bb,fa,fb,Ea,Eb,aa,ab]
    total_log=[True]*8+[False,False]
    Htot=sp.Matrix([[sp.simplify((x if l else 1)*sp.diff(Rtot,x)/Rtot) for x,l in zip(total_vars,total_log)]])
    check("exact_total_pair_log_J",all(eq(a,b) for a,b in zip(Htot,sp.Matrix([[0,0,1,-1,1,-1,-3,5,-1/ha,1/hb]]))))
    a_of_E=sp.Function("alpha_a_of_E")(Ea)
    b_of_E=sp.Function("alpha_b_of_E")(Eb)
    Rtot_energy=Rtot.subs({aa:a_of_E,ab:b_of_E})
    energy_chain=sp.simplify(Ea*sp.diff(Rtot_energy,Ea)/Rtot_energy+Eb*sp.diff(Rtot_energy,Eb)/Rtot_energy)
    expected_energy_chain=2-Ea*sp.diff(a_of_E,Ea)/(1+a_of_E)+Eb*sp.diff(b_of_E,Eb)/(1+b_of_E)
    check("total_pair_energy_chain_includes_atomic_response",eq(energy_chain,expected_energy_chain))
    check("same_numbers_two_bases_have_ICC_factor",eq(Rtot.subs({ba:Ia,bb:Ib})/Rphot,hb/ha))
    ba_from_phot=(1-extra)*Ia*ha/D
    bb_from_phot=(1-extra)*Ib*hb/D
    check("consistent_photon_total_basis_conversion_agrees",eq(Rtot.subs({ba:ba_from_phot,bb:bb_from_phot}),Rphot))
    check("shared_additive_alpha_not_generally_cancelled",eq(sp.diff(sp.log(hb/ha),aa)+sp.diff(sp.log(hb/ha),ab),1/hb-1/ha))
    hA,hB=sp.symbols("h_a h_b",positive=True)
    check("common_multiplicative_h_factor_cancels",eq((vscale*hB)/(vscale*hA),hB/hA))

    # Exact affine law in actual log-coordinate random inputs, not actual
    # covariance inferred from published marginal errors.
    # y=(ln Z,ln Ia,ln Ib,ln fa,ln fb,ln Ea,ln Eb), Z=s(1-extra)/(tau D).
    A=sp.Matrix([[1,1,0,1,0,-3,0],[1,0,1,0,1,0,-5]])
    contrast=sp.Matrix([[1,-1]])
    h=contrast*A
    Sigma=sp.zeros(7)
    for i in range(7):
        for j in range(i,7):
            value=sp.symbols(f"cov_y_{i}_{j}",real=True)
            Sigma[i,j]=Sigma[j,i]=value
    SigmaB=A*Sigma*A.T
    variance=sp.expand((contrast*SigmaB*contrast.T)[0])
    check("exact_affine_log_covariance_contrast",eq(variance,(h*Sigma*h.T)[0]))
    check("common_log_normalizer_all_covariances_cancel",all(Sigma[0,j] not in variance.free_symbols for j in range(7)))
    vs=sp.symbols("var_log_common_strength",nonnegative=True)
    common_cov=vs*sp.ones(2)
    check("rank_one_common_strength_covariance_annihilates",(contrast*common_cov*contrast.T)[0]==0)
    ve=sp.symbols("var_log_common_energy_scale",nonnegative=True)
    energy_response=sp.Matrix([-3,-5])
    check("common_energy_scale_covariance_survives",(contrast*(ve*energy_response*energy_response.T)*contrast.T)[0]==4*ve)

    ga,gb,gc=sp.Rational(57,100),sp.Rational(24,100),sp.Rational(19,100)
    check("single_parent_centers_and_selected_intensity_ratio",ga+gb+gc==1 and ga/gb==sp.Rational(19,8))
    check("radiative_fractions_not_implicitly_one",eq(Rphot/ Rphot.subs({fa:1,fb:1}),fa/fb))
    check("zero_component_log_edges",Rphot.subs(fa,0)==0 and sp.limit(Rphot,fb,0,dir="+")==sp.oo)
    foa=oldFO["FO_baseline"]["B1-I18-401p2"]
    fob=oldFO["FO_baseline"]["B1-I18-757p4"]
    alpha_fo_a=F(foa["alpha_T"]["value"]);alpha_fo_b=F(fob["alpha_T"]["value"])
    factor=(1+alpha_fo_b)/(1+alpha_fo_a)
    check("existing_FO_total_pair_modifier",factor==F(1046,1075))
    sigma_a,sigma_b,sigma_c=F(6,100),F(2,100),F(2,100)
    check("conditional_joint_SD_normalization_triangle_fails",sigma_a>sigma_b+sigma_c)
    for rel,sha in protected.items():check("immutable_input_after",digest(root/rel)==sha)
    check("substantive_budget_at_most_40",sum(counts.values())<40)

    codepath=Path(__file__).resolve()
    return {
        "schema_version":1,"created_at_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "artifact_kind":"Day9-uncredited-preview-L2-one-parent-cross-branch-strength-ratio-and-shared-covariance",

        "parent_day_index":8,"day_index":8,"preview_day_index":9,"partial_day_indices":[9],
        "course_credit_awarded":False,"Day10_opened":False,"run_closed":False,"new_session_or_goal":False,
        "new_source_or_nucleus":False,"L4":False,"experimental_data_fit":False,"actual_covariance_supplied":False,
        "session_id":run["session_id"],"resume_command":run["resume_command"],

            "unit_receipt":{"path":UNIT_REL,"sha256":UNIT_SHA},
            "read_existing_pages":["knowledge/synthesis/high-spin-lifetime-strength-deformation.md","knowledge/observables/bm1-be2-ratio.md","knowledge/sources/mukhopadhyay-2008-136nd-transition-rates.md"],
            "already_explicit":"Generic photon/total branching, absolute-strength normalization, single-gamma M1/E2 cancellation and J Sigma J^T were already recorded. The observable page already preserves unknown mixing fractions as an extraction assumption.",

It is not a new experimental conclusion.",
            "not_same_gamma_mixing_ratio":prior["mixed_gamma_absolute_strengths"]["same_gamma_B_ratio"],
